value.summary: cheerful puppet satirist. Immediate want: perform missing-village list safely. Hidden depth: receives scripts from an unknown black-scale patron.

Socially awkward button collector and gifted chalk-land surveyor who explains sinkholes at alarming length. Wants the Button Hills mapped safely; recognizes soil movement and old foundations; freezes when praised publicly. Corresponds with Nan Wimple in diagrams rather than letters. Respect for her work without forcing her into ceremony earns fierce loyalty.

Cringeworthy minor noble and enthusiastic host at the Courteous Ruin, forever practicing historical greetings. Wants claimants to honor guest law; knows family histories and recipes better than warfare; desperately needs the manor to matter. Corresponds with Sera Lark about pageants. He gives up his claim when the guest book can protect living families.
eccentric funeral composer. Immediate want: win the Greyharrow choir trial. Hidden depth: one hymn encodes veteran testimony.

Warm rogue and bath attendant who trades gossip for chores but will not reveal medical confidences. Wants the spring restored; knows underground service passages and social alliances; owes dangerous lenders for a relative's care. Friendly rival to Della Crookshaw over remedies. Clearing her debt honestly makes her stop facilitating small smuggling.

Strict traditionalist and keeper of Borrowed Bell Isle who corrects provenance stories mid-sentence. Wants the disputed bell to remain until its rescue record is heard; recognizes bronze, inscriptions, and storm tones; fears compromise dishonors ancestors. Her mainland counterpart is a childhood pen friend. Shared public recitation can turn ownership into custodianship.
strict reform candidate. Immediate want: centralize emergency command. Hidden depth: genuinely wants faster flood response, not tyranny.

Gentle grump and Latchwater sluice keeper who complains in exact measurements. Wants water theft stopped; can hear gate faults through a timber handle; carries guilt over ignoring an old miner's warning. Her estranged brother belongs to the Long Bench Union. Recovering the sealed workers' names matters more to her than punishing the culprit.

Strict glassmaker with exquisite manners and an unexpectedly competitive interest in children's spinning tops. Wants the moth swarm understood before rivals close his furnace; knows heat, sand, glass flaws, and contracts; assumes apprentices conceal errors. Owes the Silver Pear Society money. He changes after an apprentice's observation proves more valuable than his reputation.
eccentric lens maker. Immediate want: explain dragon joke in flawless glass. Hidden depth: unknowingly reproduced Ilyr's private mark.
socially awkward brilliant forger. Immediate want: clear her name. Hidden depth: admires the counterfeit seal and knows its maker trained in Aster Quay.

Quietly intense orchard diver who communicates care by sharpening other people's tools. Wants treasure seekers away from Drowned Door levees; can hold breath, read submerged masonry, and graft fruit trees; distrusts scholars after a theft. Has exchanged seeds with Cloud Apricot Farm. Returning credit and control over finds earns her expertise.

Laid-back spring keeper who never hurries and somehow has water ready before anyone asks. Wants caravans to share diminishing water; knows hidden cisterns and burial etiquette; is physically unable to inspect the steep site alone. Once guided Karsh Veyru's copper agents without knowing it. He speaks only when offered practical aid, not interrogation.
laid-back ferryman-storyteller. Immediate want: keep Old Aur Island public. Hidden depth: remembers a foundation exposed in childhood.

Strict royal forester with immaculate boots, severe eyebrows, and a private collection of badly carved wooden ducks. Wants storm timber recorded before anyone cuts it; knows oak age, charcoal fraud, and woodland law; cannot admit his deputy has been covering his mistakes. Owes Elowen Pike a fair hearing. Evidence that villagers protected saplings during hardship turns his suspicion into advocacy.

Overprepared road keeper whose emergency list includes spare jokes sorted by audience. Wants the Patient Stair made safe; reads wear, crowds, and mountain risk; sympathizes with the saboteur more than he admits. His dismissed colleague moved the markers. He opposes punishment if officials accept an enforceable maintenance plan.
laid-back salvage diver. Immediate want: identify warm water source. Hidden depth: found Concord stone under the breakwater.

Laid-back Gannet Mercy rescuer whose calm ends abruptly when anyone neglects rope care. Wants the unidentified survivor protected; reads currents and shock responses; privately dreads returning to the water after a failed rescue. Exchanges rescue reports with the Houses of Rescue. A companion admitting fear without shame helps him sail again.
strict naval legalist and bride. Immediate want: make marriage treaty explicit. Hidden depth: plans to publish side agreements both courts prefer hidden.
fussy bell scholar. Immediate want: retain family pattern rights. Hidden depth: altered an alarm to hide a mine collapse years ago.
